primaryDecision: Reconstruct case determination and contestability as a sparse practical layer over frozen GDF3 plus GPR1 authority. Persist determinations and contest/request workflow identity only where a GamePractice exposes independently meaningful binding case status or contest workflows; derive lineage, current official status, certification, finality/contestability and basis views from those records plus current authority/policy. Do not turn pre-commit plan review, verification, provider decisions or ordinary World terminal state into adjudication by terminology alone.

sourceOrWorkflowRecords: ContestRequestRecord when a practice exposes a request/appeal/protest/reconsideration workflow
owner-local determination lineage/supersession relation events or fields
sourceDerivedBoundary.reason: GDF3 requires anti-collapse responsibility but not a universal Case/Review/Appeal ontology. Practical workflow identity is sometimes worth persisting; currentness, finality, official status, lineage and certification are safer as derived views over determination/workflow records plus GPR1 authority and current policy.

AuthoritativeDeterminationRecord.purpose: Persist one authoritative determination event/result when a Game/PlayPractice exposes an independently meaningful binding case status.
AuthoritativeDeterminationRecord.admissionBoundary: Create/use this practical record only when CaseDeterminationBoundary applies; ordinary direct execution/action admission/verification should not be wrapped in a determination record by default.
AuthoritativeDeterminationRecord.truthRule: The record establishes current/prior official practice status only through its admitted authority/currentness/scope semantics; statusPayload is not WorldTruth by identity.
AuthoritativeDeterminationRecord.immutabilityRule: Prefer append/supersede history rather than rewriting prior determination records. A later review/reclassification may change the current official status while the earlier determination remains historical.
forbiddenImplications: deterministic computation is non-adjudicative by identity

DeterminationBasisTrace.purpose: Expose the minimum material basis provenance for explanation, review and audit without requiring a universal EvidenceSet, NormApplication object or hidden reasoning trace.
inputs: basis source records referenced by the determination
laws: case/evidence/canonical-state basis remains distinguishable from norm/evaluation/application basis when counterfactually material
basis trace need not contain full rationale or chain-of-thought
observation/reference in the trace is not truth by identity
missing optional basis detail does not invalidate closed deterministic determinations when the distinction is not material

CaseDeterminationBoundaryDiagnostic.purpose: Prevent both over-modeling ordinary execution as adjudication and under-modeling independent binding case status.
positiveSignals: binding official/practice status can change while underlying event/history remains fixed
binding authority/currentness can change while underlying event/history remains fixed
material determination basis can change current binding status without rewriting underlying event/history
negativeSignals: result is only direct current transition/action-admission semantics
verification only confirms an execution/result and creates no independently meaningful binding case status
proposal/plan review occurs before commitment and creates no independent official case status
provider/model decision is only cognition/policy selection

ContestRequestRecord.purpose: Provide one reusable workflow identity for a party/system request that a current determination or determination-related matter be reconsidered/reviewed/appealed/protested, without forcing Review and Appeal to be universal ontology categories.
laws: request submission != review admission
request admission != review outcome
requester identity != review authority
request does not itself suspend determination or enforcement unless current practice policy says so
request may target content/status, case basis, norm/application basis, procedure, authority/currentness or enforcement/remedy relation depending on local practice

ReviewRequestView.purpose: Expose a Human/Agent-friendly Review Request when the local contest channel is defined as review/reconsideration.
ReviewRequestView.law: ReviewRequest is useful workflow vocabulary, but the label does not create review authority or guarantee replay/correction.

AppealRequestView.purpose: Expose a Human/Agent-friendly Appeal when the local practice defines a party-initiated appeal/protest channel.
AppealRequestView.law: Appeal is not Review by universal identity and does not guarantee a review, stay, reversal or correction; it is a practice-defined contest channel with its own admission semantics.

ReviewContestabilityProfile.purpose: Answer whether/how a current determination can be contested or reviewed now, by whom, under what authority/policy, against which aspects, until when and with what interim effect.
laws: contestability != determination content
review authority comes from GPR1 effective authority/current policy rather than the request record
closed_within_queried_scope does not mean metaphysically immutable forever
review may exist without appeal and appeal may follow local processes not equivalent to generic review

DecisionLineage.purpose: Reconstruct the history/currentness relationship among authoritative determinations for audit, explanation and current-status projection.
laws: lineage may branch or contain multiple scope-specific currents; it is not universally a single chain
reversal != history erasure
reversal != full World rollback
later current status does not delete prior determination provenance
lineage graph is derived and not an independent decision authority

OfficialStatusView.purpose: Expose current binding practice/official status by scope/category without confusing it with underlying WorldTruth.
laws: official != true
different categories/scopes can hold different official statuses over the same underlying event/history without contradiction
official status may change retrospectively without rewriting original World history

CertificationView.purpose: Expose certification when the current authoritative determination operation is certification/verification-of-category/record status; do not equate all official statuses with certification.
laws: Certification is an authoritative case-status operation in applicable practices, not generic execution verification
certified != WorldTruth
OfficialStatus != Certification by identity
verification receipt may be basis for certification without itself being the certification

FinalityStatusView.purpose: Provide useful pending/reviewable/currently-final/superseded UI vocabulary derived from current contestability and lineage rather than a persistent truth flag.
laws: finality != truth
finality != correctness
finality != eternal immutability
policy or authority changes can change future contestability without rewriting the old determination

MissionControlProposalReview.finding: Mission Control proposal-review exposes player inspection/approve/deny of pending proposals before authoritative World execution. It creates no independently meaningful prior binding case status and should not be generalized into GPR2 ReviewRequest/DecisionLineage.

VerificationReceipt.finding: World/Host verification checks retained execution/effect correctness. It may serve as basis for a future certification determination but does not itself create official category/case status.

TeamAuthorityDecision.finding: permit/require-human/deny resolves action-authority policy for one candidate; it is not an authoritative adjudicative case status by identity.

ProviderOrAgentDecision.finding: Model/provider decisions select candidate actions/directives under bounded context; model confidence/rationale do not create GDF3 binding status.

WorldMissionStatus.finding: mission running/victory/failure is currently produced directly by deterministic World transition semantics. No separate official case-status layer is evidenced in the current Station Zero product.

ReplayDiagnosis.finding: Replay/diagnosis reconstructs action/authority/evidence chains and counterfactual diagnostics but currently does not represent a lineage of superseding authoritative case determinations.

implementationDecision.reason: Current Station Zero uses proposal review, action authority, verification, World terminal status and replay, but none currently proves a persistent independent GDF3 case-status consumer requiring generic determination/review tables. GPR2 should remain a reusable practical contract set until a GameForm such as tournament/judged/moderated/certified play actually consumes it.
safeImmediateCandidates: documentation terminology guards separating proposal review, verification, certification and adjudication
pure derived projection helpers only when a concrete determination source appears
